data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 18.715m. During 2015 there was a gross prior-year release of GBP 6.898m (approximately 36.9% of opening gross claims outstanding), described in the report as favourable prior year development. The report does not attribute this movement to any specific named events or to individual lines of business.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m (2014: nil).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and gross prior year movement are taken from Note 17 'Technical provisions' (gross columns) on page 32. The report also contains a narrative line on page 27 noting 'favourable prior year development of GBP 4.8m' (net). No line-of-business breakout of the prior year movement or any named catastrophe events affecting prior years is provided. The claims development table is limited (shows 2014 and 2015 columns) and does not allow detailed per-LOBS PYD allocation.
